Spec: # ANT UI - MVP Design Document

**Project**: ant-ui  
**Generated**: 2024-11-01  
**Version**: 3.0 (MVP - File-Based Only)

---

## Executive Summary
...

taskQueue.name: Implement Backend REST API Routes
taskQueue.description: Create Express routes: projects (GET, POST, DELETE), features (GET, POST, DELETE), files (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), session (GET), commands (POST design/code/learn, POST cancel), settings (GET, PUT). Include WebSocket handlers
taskQueue.validationRationale: API endpoints are critical integration points

taskQueue.name: Implement App Providers and Routing
taskQueue.description: Create app layer: ThemeProvider, QueryProvider (TanStack Query with cache config), WebSocketProvider (connect to backend), React Router setup, ErrorBoundary, global styles, and App.tsx entry point
taskQueue.validationRationale: App shell, will validate after widgets

taskQueue.name: Implement Feature Zustand Stores
taskQueue.description: Create Zustand stores for features: task-execute (command state, execution control), session-monitor (session updates), log-stream (log buffer with MAX_LOGS=10000), workflow-monitor (workflow state). Compose into root store
taskQueue.validationRationale: State management, will validate with feature UI

taskQueue.name: Implement Session Monitor Feature
taskQueue.description: Create session-monitor feature: useSessionUpdates hook (WebSocket subscription), session store integration, SessionStatus UI component
taskQueue.validationRationale: Feature component, batch validate with other features

taskQueue.name: Implement Log Stream Feature
taskQueue.description: Create log-stream feature: useLogStream hook (WebSocket log_line subscription), log buffer management, log filtering logic
taskQueue.validationRationale: Feature component, batch validate with other features

taskQueue.name: Implement Workflow Monitor Feature
taskQueue.description: Create workflow-monitor feature: useWorkflowUpdates hook (WebSocket workflow_update subscription), workflow state management
taskQueue.validationRationale: Feature component, batch validate with other features

taskQueue.name: Implement Task Execute Feature
taskQueue.description: Create task-execute feature: ExecuteButton, StopButton, TaskControls UI components, API methods (executeDesign, executeCode, cancelTask), store with execution state, RecursionLimitModal
taskQueue.validationRationale: Feature component, batch validate with other features

taskQueue.name: Implement Project Create Feature
taskQueue.description: Create project-create feature: CreateProjectButton, CreateProjectModal UI, createProject API method, store for modal state
taskQueue.validationRationale: Feature component, batch validate with other features

taskQueue.name: Implement Feature Create Feature
taskQueue.description: Create feature-create feature: CreateFeatureButton, CreateFeatureModal UI, createFeature API method, store for modal state
taskQueue.validationRationale: Feature component, batch validate with other features

taskQueue.name: Implement File Upload Feature
taskQueue.description: Create file-upload feature: FileUploadZone (drag-drop), FileList UI, uploadFile API method, store for upload state
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final validation after batch feature creation

taskQueue.name: Implement Workflow Graph Widget
taskQueue.description: Create WorkflowGraph widget using React Flow 11.10.0: WorkflowGraph component, CustomNode, CustomEdge, useWorkflow hook, layoutEngine (auto-layout algorithm), integrate with workflow-monitor feature
taskQueue.validationRationale: Widget component, batch validate with other widgets

taskQueue.name: Implement Task Queue Panel Widget
taskQueue.description: Create TaskQueuePanel widget: TaskQueuePanel component, TaskCard, PriorityBadge, useTaskQueue hook, display task queue and completed tasks from session
taskQueue.validationRationale: Widget component, batch validate with other widgets

taskQueue.name: Implement Terminal Panel Widget
taskQueue.description: Create TerminalPanel widget with virtual scrolling: TerminalPanel, TerminalOutput (react-window FixedSizeList), LogLine component, TerminalControls, useLogs hook, auto-scroll to bottom, log filtering
taskQueue.validationRationale: Widget component, batch validate with other widgets

taskQueue.name: Implement Project Sidebar Widget
taskQueue.description: Create ProjectSidebar widget: ProjectSidebar component, ProjectTree, ProjectNode, FeatureNode, useProjects hook, project/feature selection state
taskQueue.validationRationale: Widget component, batch validate with other widgets

taskQueue.name: Implement Header Widget
taskQueue.description: Create Header widget: Header component, ActionButtons (create project, create feature, settings), branding
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final validation after batch widget creation

taskQueue.name: Implement Dashboard Page
taskQueue.description: Create DashboardPage: compose all widgets (Header, ProjectSidebar, WorkflowGraph, TaskQueuePanel, TerminalPanel) using CSS Grid layout (280px sidebar, flexible content, 320px right panel, resizable terminal). Implement desktop-only layout (1920x1080 minimum)
taskQueue.validationRationale: Page composition, will validate after settings page

taskQueue.name: Implement Settings Page
taskQueue.description: Create SettingsPage: settings form, API integration (GET/PUT /api/settings), settings store
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final validation after page creation

taskQueue.name: Implement Performance Optimizations
taskQueue.description: Add performance optimizations: React.memo for TaskBadge and other components, useMemo for expensive computations, debounced file watching (100ms), log buffer management (MAX_LOGS=10000), TanStack Query cache configuration (staleTime: 30s, cacheTime: 5min)
taskQueue.validationRationale: Performance features require runtime validation

taskQueue.name: Implement Resizable Terminal Panel
taskQueue.description: Add terminal resize functionality: drag handle, mouse event handlers, height constraints (min: 200px, max: 600px, default: 300px), persist resize state
taskQueue.validationRationale: Interactive feature requires runtime validation

taskQueue.name: Implement WebSocket Reconnection Logic
taskQueue.description: Enhance WebSocket client with exponential backoff reconnection: max 5 attempts, exponential delay (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 10s max), connection status UI indicator
taskQueue.validationRationale: Critical real-time feature requires validation

taskQueue.name: Implement Error Handling
taskQueue.description: Add comprehensive error handling: ErrorBoundary component, error toast notifications, API error handling, WebSocket error handling, command execution error handling
taskQueue.validationRationale: Error handling requires runtime validation

taskQueue.name: Final Integration & Verification
taskQueue.description: Verify all features from specification are fully implemented: Feature-Sliced Design architecture, Clean Architecture with Repository Pattern, real-time WebSocket updates, file watching (chokidar), workflow graph visualization (React Flow), task queue monitoring, terminal output streaming with virtual scrolling, project/feature management, file upload, task execution (design/code/learn), desktop-only layout (1920x1080), resizable terminal, performance optimizations, error handling. Check for missing components, incomplete functionality, or gaps. Ensure the complete ANT UI application works as intended with single-machine deployment and direct file system access
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final comprehensive validation of entire application

currentTask.name: Implement Backend Application Services
currentTask.description: Create CommandService (execute design/code/learn tasks), FileWatchService (watch session.json and logs with debouncing), WebSocketService (broadcast events, handle subscriptions). Implement use cases: ExecuteDesignTask, ExecuteCodeTask
currentTask.validationRationale: Critical backend services require full validation
